headline: CaixaBank and other Spanish banks hire KPMG to create anti-Mythos plan
summary: CECA has hired KPMG to create a cybersecurity plan for Spanish banks, including CaixaBank. The move follows an ECB warning to banks about challenges linked to Anthropic's technology.
why: CaixaBank is one of Spain's largest banks, and the ECB supervises major euro-area lenders. Cyber resilience and supervisory expectations are key risk factors for bank investors.

impacts.name: CaixaBank
impacts.why: CaixaBank is among the Spanish banks commissioning a cybersecurity plan after the ECB warning.
